summary: Observation, not a proposal. The first real noble bake (Home, 2026-10-25, FS-GG/.github#4516 comment 6394062164) failed in provision-image.sh at offline apt-get update (rc 100): for some indexes apt printed 'Get ... Packages', 'Ign', then 'File not found .../Packages' (an uncompressed index that is not locked; only Packages.xz was acquired). The offline simulation passed because it appended -o APT::Sandbox::User=root, a difference from the guest, which runs apt with the default _apt privilege-dropping sandbox. The snapshot Release declares Acquire-By-Hash, so apt first probes by-hash/SHA256/<hash> paths the acquired tree lacks; that probe followed by the ordinary Packages.xz fetch is normal and harmless. Reproduced offline in a rootless podman container with _apt mapped (uidmap) over a chmod -R go-rwx copy of the input tree using the previous noble-apt.sh: the Packages.xz fetch fails and apt falls through Packages.gz and the uncompressed Packages (neither locked), giving Home's errors; with readable files it passes, and APT::Sandbox::User=root alone cures the hostile tree while Acquire::By-Hash=no alone does not (independent review). The modes of Home's actual tree were not observed, so the trigger is inferred from the reproduction, not confirmed. Fix delivered by the Coordination change that carries this record: the shared noble-apt.sh now fixes APT::Sandbox::User=root (the cure), Acquire::By-Hash=no (noise only) and unsets APT_CONFIG; an Acquire::CompressionTypes::Order option was tried and found to be a no-op for fallbacks, so it is not used; the option digest is locked in apt-transaction.json (aptOptionsSha256) and both provision-image.sh and simulate-noble-bake.sh refuse unless their options hash to it; the simulation is run over a hostile-mode copy. Lesson: make the simulation add or remove no option relative to the real recipe, enforce that by a locked digest, and run it under the hostile input modes a builder may produce. Citations are the pre-fix revision.
title: A bake simulation must run the guest's exact apt configuration, including the _apt sandbox
